scope: Actual literal raw-R50 material coupons proving complex binary function arguments and exact-zero phase.
restrictions: Original hypotheses, pre-upgrade evaluator errors and all false native/literal gates are retained verbatim.
One complex atan2 pole is an actual fatal native IMSL error with no matrix; it does not certify complex atan2 semantics.
Negative physical resistance is not accepted by our passive material lowerer despite native fallback.
Complex max/min/fmod use signed magnitude, negative exactly when real part is negative; pure imaginary and -0 real operands are positive.
min/max ties retain the second complex operand; int and fmod exact zero reset positive.
Printed quantity values have six significant digits; native.s2p retains independent full complex response.
